Container.Name: JustDNS
Container.Overview:
JustDNS is a self-hosted filtering DNS resolver for your whole network. It blocks ads, trackers and malware, and its privacy dashboard shows which companies your devices contact, with a per-device breakdown and a world map of where answers resolve. It ships encrypted upstreams (DNS-over-TLS) by default, per-device and per-group policies, DNSSEC validation, user accounts with roles and TOTP, and optional multi-node high availability.
Point your router's or devices' DNS at this server's IP, then open the dashboard on port 8080 and finish setup in the first-run wizard.
Notes for Unraid: - The /keys volume holds the at-rest encryption key. Back it up separately from /data; losing it makes the sealed account and config files unreadable. - Ports 80 and 443 are only needed for the optional custom block page and clash with Unraid's own web UI. They are off by default here; map them to free host ports (or give the container its own IP) only if you enable the block page. - Ports 853 and 8443 are only needed if you let clients talk to JustDNS over encrypted DNS (DoT/DoH). - On Unraid, update JustDNS from the Docker tab. The upstream project's one-click in-app updater is not used in this template.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: HTTP port for the JustDNS dashboard.

Config.Name: DNS (UDP)
Config.Description: DNS service, UDP. Point your clients here.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent data: query log, lists, devices, settings.

Config.Name: Keys
Config.Description: At-rest encryption key, kept separate from Data on purpose. Back this up.

Config.Name: DNS-over-TLS (DoT)
Config.Description: Optional: encrypted client DNS over TLS. Enable in the dashboard first.

Config.Name: DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH)
Config.Description: Optional: encrypted client DNS over HTTPS. Enable in the dashboard first.

Config.Name: Block page (HTTP)
Config.Description: Optional: custom block page over HTTP. Clashes with Unraid's web UI on port 80; map to a free host port or give the container its own IP.

Config.Name: Block page (HTTPS)
Config.Description: Optional: custom block page over HTTPS. Clashes with Unraid's web UI on port 443; map to a free host port or give the container its own IP.

Config.Name: Metrics token (Prometheus)
Config.Description: Optional: set a token to enable the GET /metrics endpoint. Leave blank to keep it off.
